source: Canonical KRISHNA product requirements consolidated from project conversations, merged repository decisions, runtime acceptance and current architecture
non_negotiables: KRISHNA is the only public identity and final decision authority.
KRISHNA is standalone and independent; E:\KRISHNA-SOURCE is authoritative code and E:\Krishna-The GOD is runtime/state/models/assets.
Internal engines, specialists and adapters never replace KRISHNA authority.
Mutating, destructive, credential, external-message and other high-impact actions remain behind Policy/approval boundaries and audit.
An agent never self-declares success; evidence is checked by an independent verifier before promotion.
Unfinished commitments are never silently discarded; resume, explicitly supersede, cancel or complete them.
Runtime/UI must report observed state honestly; unavailable optional providers fail closed.
Final Krishna_AGI.exe is built only after Windows runtime, browser/UI, mobile, recovery and deployment-integrity acceptance.
KRISHNA Mobile never exposes raw shell, arbitrary filesystem access, credentials, or trading authority; sensitive actions remain behind device authorization and Core Policy.
Remote-away access is private-network-only; KRISHNA must not expose Core control APIs directly to the public Internet.
Protected and archive project roles are read-only to autonomous mutation and promotion.
Garuda is the research/evidence scout; Garudanetra is the browser/computer fabric. Neither replaces KRISHNA authority.
Every operational dashboard control must resolve to a real runtime contract; mutating priority controls use the Shared Action Bus and receive auditable action receipts.
Every delegated capability enters through Sudarshan's permissioned Action/Job architecture and leaves through the independent verifier; no framework gains authority by being powerful.

PC human navigation stays minimal: Main Menu exposes only KRISHNA and Sudarshan, with Plugins at the bottom of the main-menu group; Projects remain expandable folders with nested project chats and Rename/Delete/Share actions, and global Chats stays separate with a New Chat control. KABACH, Garuda, Garudanetra, BRAHMAGYAN, Gyan-Bhandar, NARAD, Specialists, Developer, UI Guardian, Work Progress, Activity, System and other internal KRISHNA systems remain runtime capabilities rather than visible main-menu items.

groups.title: Autonomy and supervision
requirements: Observe registered projects and system state, detect errors, plan repairs, code bounded fixes, test, restart and verify.
Manage CPU/RAM pressure and avoid uncontrolled heavy workers.
Maintain active versus protected/archive project distinction and do not mutate backups as live projects.
Continue safe routine work without babysitting and surface meaningful verified completion notifications.
Crash loops use heartbeat/supervision, exponential restart backoff and quarantine instead of endless restart storms.
Critical RAM pressure may unload resident local models without deleting model files.

groups.title: Agent-native action/runtime foundation
requirements: Agent-Native is an architectural reference/foundation only; KRISHNA remains the product, public identity and final authority.
Integration order is Shared Action Bus -> Projects/Chats -> Agent Runtime -> Jobs -> Permissions -> Audit/Rollback -> MCP/A2A -> Dispatch -> Desktop/Mobile sync -> Garuda/Garudanetra.
Operational UI controls must be backed by real runtime behavior; priority mutating controls dispatch named Shared Actions and expose an action_id receipt.
Agents, jobs, MCP and A2A adapters do not call runtime internals directly; delegated execution resolves through explicit action manifests and capabilities.
Jobs use the durable Mission Engine + backend-owned queue as execution authority; TaskLedger remains a compatibility/read surface and never competes with Mission state.
MCP/A2A are authenticated adapter boundaries over Shared Actions, not public unauthenticated control planes.
Desktop/mobile action state sync uses the existing authenticated realtime event store and does not turn KRISHNA Mobile into a dashboard or raw host-control client.
Project-code rollback remains under verified PromotionManager backups/post-checks; Shared Action rollback never weakens project promotion safeguards.

groups.title: BRAHMAGYAN deep knowledge and Rishi council
requirements: BRAHMAGYAN is KRISHNA's permanent deep-learning/research intelligence but never a second authority; all execution remains behind Sudarshan Action/Job permissions and independent verification.

Reading/search discovery is not learned knowledge. Claims mature sequentially L0 Discovered -> L1 Read -> L2 Understood -> L3 Source Verified -> L4 Cross-checked -> L5 Applied -> L6 Tested -> L7 Mastered -> L8 Connected.
Gautama performs evidence/epistemic review and Veda Vyasa compiles sufficiently cross-checked knowledge before trusted Gyan-Bhandar proposal.
Permanent Rishi/Acharya entries are lightweight role manifests, not permanent running model processes.
Modern scientific evidence and Vedic/classical knowledge remain separately labeled and are compared only after source-faithful understanding; similarities never establish scientific identity.
Contradicting evidence is retained with explicit resolution history; credible conflicts are never silently collapsed.
Temporal knowledge preserves previous/current state, validity, source history and supersession.
Trusted Gyan proposals retain traceable provenance whenever provenance is available.

Rishis may request temporary Shishya researchers through AI-HR/Sudarshan; requests are bounded by configurable total/tree budgets, concurrency is capped, execution is approval-gated, descendants inherit parent scope, and every temporary Shishya must retire after verified handover.
Before Shishya retirement, verified findings, methods, failures, corrections, evaluation, sources, provenance and useful cross-domain learning are preserved.
BRAHMAGYAN curiosity is priority/resource bounded and v1 starts no autonomous background-learning daemon.

BRAHMA is the learning governor and Gyan-Bhandar QC head: phone/PC observations route to Rishis first, then provenance/evidence/maturity/contradiction checks, Gautama review and Veda Vyasa compilation before trusted Gyan promotion.

BRAHMA preserves bi-temporal claims, source-family independence, provenance fingerprints, contradiction history, teach-back verification, memory evaluation, low-load consolidation and freshness/decay without silently deleting history.
KRISHNA Cognitive Brain provides associative concept activation above Rishi/BRAHMA/Gyan memory; related-topic retrieval can traverse typed concept links instead of relying only on exact keywords.

C6 synthesis forms structural analogy candidates, converts unresolved contradictions into research questions, derives semantic candidates from repeated episodic observations, and uses controlled forgetting only as reversible dormancy/activation-telemetry pruning; verified/provenanced/connected knowledge is never silently deleted.

C7 cross-domain hypothesis generation produces falsifiable unverified questions for Rishi or LAB BOT testing; generated hypotheses never become trusted Gyan without normal evidence maturation, BRAHMA QC and approval.
Cognitive Brain must keep Vedic/classical and modern-science tracks source-faithful: cross-track comparison is allowed, unsupported equivalence and causal transfer are rejected.

Rishi Vishvakarma is the permanent design/UI/software-craft knowledge curator; this is a KRISHNA design role inspired by traditional naming, not a claim that a historical/traditional figure practiced modern frontend engineering.

groups.title: Sudarshan work console
requirements: GPT-style persistent project chats with file attachments and real Rename, Pin, Share, Move and Delete actions.
Active Work, Verification and System Load informer.
When browser work starts, transform into a Sudarshan/Garudanetra split workspace rather than opening a dead status page.
Support project, research, investigate, plugin and developer workflows while KRISHNA selects internal engines automatically.

UI/frontend/mobile/dashboard design work uses the canonical Sudarshan Design Engine with a structured Design Genome, drift detection, bounded repair/retest loop and hard functional/visual/responsive/accessibility/security acceptance gates; Rishi Vishvakarma supplies provenance-preserving design knowledge and optional Stagehand/Storybook helpers remain non-authoritative adapters.

Sudarshan Project Brain maintains runtime-owned PROJECT, ARCHITECTURE, RULES, PHASES, DESIGN, AGENTS and MEMORY governance layers while preserving database-backed verified learning and summary context; these governance files must not silently mutate project source trees.

groups.title: Garuda research scout
requirements: Garuda owns public research/discovery/evidence gathering; it does not own Chromium sessions or browser control.
Garuda hands sourced evidence to KRISHNA; KRISHNA decides whether Garudanetra should open or interact with a selected source.
Research results remain untrusted external evidence until KRISHNA/KABACH/Verifier gates accept their use.

groups.title: Garudanetra browser/computer fabric
requirements: One canonical Garudanetra Browser Fabric owns browser/computer capability; Playwright/Chromium is the canonical verified engine.
Observe rendered DOM and accessibility-style semantic element refs, screenshots/frames, console, network, tabs, downloads and visible text.
Prefer CDP screencast for live frames with bounded screenshot fallback; live browser UI stays collapsed unless opened or owner attention is required.
Live Work controls include Pause, Take Control, Continue, Stop, Expand, navigation, tabs, typing, keypress, click, drag, scroll and bounded runtime-file upload.
Browser modes are Private, Private + Task Memory, and explicitly approved Persistent Workspace with project-specific profiles only.
Credentials/cookies remain browser session state, not learned memory; recorded entered values are redacted unless explicitly marked reusable.
Selector failures recover deterministically first, then optional Browser Harness or configured vision recovery; external recovery output is untrusted candidate evidence.
Successful selector recoveries and recorded workflows compile into distinct Gyan-Bhandar skill candidates and require verification/benchmark before Stable promotion.
Recorded workflows support bounded replay; consequential click/fill/type/upload style replay requires explicit approval.

Optional browser-use, agent-browser, BrowserCode, OpenDevBrowser, Rustwright, Lucarne, Skyvern, rrweb, Promptwright and Cereon capabilities are adapters/providers only and never silently replace the canonical engine.
UI Guardian and Developer browser verification use the same Garudanetra fabric/inspector boundary rather than creating competing browser authorities.

Garudanetra Research Fabric v2 adapts useful JetBot browser-native patterns (durable workspace, skill lifecycle, cross-task recall pattern, circuit-breaker philosophy and explicit skill distillation) without making JetBot or any other project a competing browser authority.

Garudanetra research missions coordinate specialist scouts for scientific papers, GitHub implementations/failure cases, patents/prior art, datasets/benchmarks, standards/metrology and contradictory/failed-replication evidence.
Research evidence preserves provenance, stance and quality; supporting and contradicting evidence remain visible together and unresolved contradictions block automatic truth promotion.
Research scouts run through canonical Garudanetra task-memory Playwright sessions; repeated/duplicate scout launches are circuit-broken rather than allowed to loop indefinitely.
Garudanetra may package evidence for Rishi, Shishya, LAB BOT or Gyan-candidate review, but research output remains candidate evidence until independent verification/BRAHMA QC.

Garudanetra exposes a browser-local IndexedDB scratch workspace for temporary research notes and mission summaries; it is local-only, clearable independently, and never replaces authoritative KRISHNA evidence storage.
The browser-local research workspace redacts likely credentials/tokens before persistence and stores only bounded sanitized summaries rather than raw secret-bearing browser state.
The Garudanetra UI exposes Research Fabric mission creation, per-scout launch, contradiction analysis, reusable research-skill inspection, and explicit handoff to Rishi or LAB BOT.

groups.title: Gyan-Bhandar and learning
requirements: Unified working, episodic, semantic, graph, skill and evidence memory facade.
Preserve provenance, confidence, candidate/verified state and supersession.
Codebase-Memory-MCP supplies structural code intelligence; Graft may provide persistent memory behind Gyan-Bhandar, never as a competing brain.
Repeated verified workflows can compile into deterministic skills and pass Benchmark Lab before Stable promotion.

groups.title: NARAD automation and messaging
requirements: Native KRISHNA event/workflow control plane with Draft, Candidate, Sandbox, Verified, Stable and Rejected lifecycle.
Schedules, webhooks, project/system events, execution history, retries, recovery and dead letters.
n8n, Activepieces, MCP and generic webhook integrations remain provider adapters, not KRISHNA authority.
External communication and app integrations use credential references and Policy/HITL gates.
Provider adapters cover Telegram, Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, Gmail, Google Drive, Google Sheets and Google Calendar behind Policy approval.
Credentials may be environment references or Windows DPAPI-encrypted local secret references; plaintext is never returned by status APIs.
NARAD adopts n8n-style workflow patterns natively but does not embed the n8n runtime, editor, database, queue workers, credential store or unrestricted node catalog.
NARAD workflows compile to typed action/job DAG nodes with explicit dependencies, safe data references, bounded retries, durable history, dead letters and per-run checkpoints.
Workflow data mapping supports bounded ${input.*} and ${nodes.*} lookup only; arbitrary Python/JavaScript expression evaluation is prohibited.
External webhook/provider steps are side-effecting, remain approval-gated, and are retried only when explicitly marked retry-safe.
Checkpoint resume skips already completed and independently verified nodes.
External n8n may be called only as a bounded webhook adapter behind Sudarshan; it never becomes KRISHNA's scheduler or authority.

groups.title: Specialists and developer
requirements: Select bounded specialists on demand for architecture, backend, frontend, debugging, DevOps, security, testing, research, data, UI and documentation.
Flow: User -> KRISHNA -> Planner -> specialists -> Critic -> independent Verifier -> KRISHNA decision -> Action.
Autonomous Developer uses Git evidence, shadow/candidate workspace, tests, browser/API inspection and rollback/promotion.
OpenMontage belongs to the media/YouTube worker boundary, not KRISHNA Core reasoning.

groups.title: KABACH — Security & Privacy Guardian
requirements: Project defensive-security, privacy-audit and boundary guardian under KRISHNA authority; Sudarshan remains the independent verification/release gate.
Privacy Guardian is internal only and never appears as a permanent MAIN MENU item.
Collect only privacy-relevant browser/device/network/mobile/web evidence for owner-controlled or explicitly scoped tests; do not use it to identify unrelated third parties.
Use local-first privacy storage; normalized history is redacted and sensitive network/device/fingerprint evidence is encrypted where secure Windows storage is available.

Browser privacy checks reuse Garudanetra/Playwright with temporary isolated contexts and inspect browser exposure, fingerprint surfaces, GPC, permissions, storage, WebRTC candidate types and third-party request domains without retaining raw candidate values.
Tracking URL cleaning removes only known tracking parameters and preserves unknown/functional parameters by default.
Tracker intelligence uses provider abstractions and evidence learning; no licensing-restricted tracker database is hard-wired into KRISHNA core and no single observation triggers automatic blocking.
Network privacy probes are disabled unless an owner-controlled external observation service is explicitly configured; remote probe services require HTTPS.

Owned KRISHNA web endpoints are checked for HTTPS/redirects, HSTS, CSP, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, content-type/frame protection, cross-origin headers, cookie attributes and CORS-related exposure.

KRISHNA Mobile privacy gates include conservative static APK checks, permission inventory when AAPT is available, cleartext URL signals and tracker SDK signatures; full release gates still require real-device/dynamic evidence.
MobSF/OpenWPM/Exodus/AmIUnique-style systems remain external adapters or methodology references according to their licenses; restrictive code is not merged into KRISHNA core.
Privacy baselines and regression comparisons preserve test-suite/profile provenance; methodology changes are marked instead of silently comparing incompatible results.
Privacy risk is descriptive rather than a fake universal score; never claim fully anonymous, untraceable, impossible to fingerprint or 100% private.
Do not automatically alter browser/system privacy settings or install extensions without configured policy/owner approval.
Privacy release gates block only required tests/findings defined by policy; informational findings remain informational.
Inspect tool permissions, untrusted content and egress boundaries; defensive research may be delegated through Garuda/Garudanetra while KRISHNA keeps decision authority.
Keep evidence/audit receipts for protected project and privacy boundaries.

groups.title: KRISHNA Mobile
requirements: Conversation-only secure voice/text interface; no dashboard, health-panel, project-list or raw-shell UI.
Use the same KRISHNA Core conversation/task state as PC and notify after meaningful verified completed work.
Persist device identity/credential locally; sensitive actions use device authorization rather than voice alone.
Support file/photo attachment and Odia/English conversation.
Owner voice gate may filter wake/listen flow locally but is not strong biometric security.
Remote-away usage requires secure transport and must not expose raw host shell/filesystem APIs.
Phone image/file attachments can be passed into the same KRISHNA conversation; supported images use local multimodal reasoning and evidence linkage.
KRISHNA Mobile accepts only LAN/private-overlay Core targets and refuses public Internet control targets.
Mobile must never expose raw shell, arbitrary host filesystem, plaintext credential, or trading execution APIs.
HAWKEYE mobile camera mode exposes explicit LEARN, SEARCH, PHOTO+DATA and REC+DATA controls without adding a dashboard.
Public research opens in a user-browser Custom Tab with no KRISHNA JavaScript bridge injected into third-party pages.

groups.title: Voice and avatar
requirements: Jarvis-like Odia conversation with explicit microphone/listening state.
Wake word 'Krishna' and owner-only wake are desired; sensitive actions still require device authentication.
Child KRISHNA avatar with states Idle, Flute, Listening, Talking, Dhyan, Searching and Working.
Final avatar goal includes rigged body animation, facial animation and lip sync when a verified asset/provider is available.
Native local Odia voice target uses AI4Bharat IndicConformer-style STT and Indic-TTS-style workers behind provider boundaries.
Always-listening wake-word target uses a local custom 'Krishna' wake model; wake detection is activation, never authentication.

groups.title: Command Center UI
requirements: Dark navy/gold/teal polished Command Center; Liquid Glass, Bento and Spatial UI used selectively.
KRISHNA Home is distinct from Sudarshan and should feel like the real operating presence, not a validation lab.
Vrindavan-inspired real-world home reference remains a target while operational pages stay functional.
Long-term UI stack target: React/shadcn, Dockview, React Flow, xterm and React Three Fiber with a Stable/Candidate/Experimental/Rejected GUI registry.
Sudarshan stays compact and contextual while KRISHNA Home keeps the larger avatar/core presence; Project -> Chats hierarchy remains visually clear.
Garudanetra Live Work includes an Expand mode and contextual owner controls rather than permanent clutter.

groups.title: Local tools and models
requirements: Prefer free/local tools where practical; Ollama/local models are implementation details behind privacy-aware routing.
Codebase-Memory-MCP, Graft, selected Agency-Agents, n8n and OpenMontage are integrated through bounded adapters.
Cloud model/API fallbacks must honor project privacy and credential isolation.
Optional providers are never reported active merely because source code is cloned.
Free-only model gateway profiles use encrypted local credentials and must never silently fall through to paid providers.
Local multimodal vision remains local-only unless a future project policy explicitly permits another provider.
OpenRouter free-cloud integration reuses one Windows-DPAPI encrypted OpenRouter credential across bounded text/vision/image adapters instead of duplicating the same API key per model.

OpenRouter cloud execution requires a fresh provider catalog preflight proving the selected model's relevant prices are exactly zero; missing, opaque, expired or non-zero pricing fails closed and never falls through to a paid model.
Paid cloud inference is disabled by default even when a paid credential/profile exists; it requires the explicit KRISHNA_ALLOW_PAID_CLOUD=1 operator opt-in and is never part of free-only routing.

Local-only, restricted, explicitly sensitive, or likely credential/secret-bearing payloads must never be sent to OpenRouter; local multimodal processing remains the default for private HAWKEYE/BHOOMIPUTRA evidence.

OpenRouter free model selection is capability- and role-aware for coding, reasoning, vision, medical research and general work; expiring models are deprioritized and catalog availability is treated as dynamic rather than permanent.

OpenRouter image generation uses the dedicated Images API and is permitted only for live zero-priced image models; Ming Image is prompt-only, no reference images or forced dimensions/aspect ratios are sent, and generated artifacts remain local KRISHNA runtime state.

Paid OpenRouter speech, video, image or other media models remain disabled under free-only policy unless a future live catalog proves the requested operation is zero-cost or the owner explicitly enables paid cloud.

Direct provider profiles merely labelled free_only remain explicit-use adapters, not automatic zero-cost fallbacks; a native direct adapter may enter automatic routing only when it independently proves the configured account is non-billable immediately before inference and still enforces KRISHNA privacy guards.

Cloudflare Workers AI is the first verified native direct-free adapter: it requires an encrypted account-root profile, an @cf/* model, Billing Read subscription preflight, no active Workers-paid subscription, and a paid-only-model denylist; quota or paid-model errors stop rather than falling through to billing.
Automatic model hierarchy is Ollama/local -> live-zero OpenRouter -> live-zero-billing verified native direct APIs -> remaining local fallback/STOP; paid-cloud fallback is never silent.

KRISHNA Model Scout separates discovery from installation/activation: candidate models require benchmark evidence, duplicate/resource checks and local-capability admission before promotion; candidate metadata or a provider's free label never establishes zero-cost cloud eligibility.

groups.title: KRISHNA Glass roadmap
requirements: After PC and mobile stability: camera/vision, audio, IMU/head tracking, gestures, optional wrist/ring input and AR display.
Local low-latency Neural Action Graph/reflex layer performs observe -> decide -> act -> verify under KRISHNA authority.
Shared session/control with PC/mobile; hardware selection favors open interfaces and reasonable cost.
WearableBridge records only verified device capabilities; vendor camera/display/gesture support is never claimed before hardware adapter testing.
Phase 1 wearable bridge is Bluetooth audio/microphone/speaker plus phone camera; vendor display/camera and gesture/IMU/wrist/ring remain capability-gated.

groups.title: Canonical source, deployment and product truth
requirements: E:\KRISHNA-SOURCE is authoritative source; E:\Krishna-The GOD is runtime/state/assets. GitHub origin, source commit, deployment manifest and running runtime must identify the same accepted commit before release.
The repository default/integration line is the only source used for deployment; divergent feature branches and PRs are candidates until reconciled and merged.
Runtime acceptance is authoritative over code presence. A failed acceptance rolls back the provisional manifest and must not start the final runtime.
Repository-only contracts such as .github workflows are read from KRISHNA_SOURCE_ROOT during deployed tests rather than copied into runtime.
Architecture truth must explicitly classify canonical modules, compatibility copies, legacy snapshots, duplicate implementations and orphan/unreferenced modules.
Generated/stale source-tree and test-report artifacts must never override the current requirements ledger/completion matrix/runtime evidence.

groups.title: HAWKEYE coordinated perception and reasoning
requirements: HAWKEYE is one coordinated runtime under KRISHNA, not an alias for BHOOMIPUTRA and not merely six learning-role definitions.
PERCEPTION answers what is actually seen/heard and preserves source/evidence state.
PHYSIO handles supplied measurable physical signals only; it must not infer private mental state, deception or diagnosis from weak proxies.
BEHAVIOR records observable actions/events only and separates observation from interpretation.
TEMPORAL compares current evidence with prior observations/sessions and records what changed.
DIAGNOSTIC forms bounded fault hypotheses, identifies the next safe test/measurement, and distinguishes observed/measured/inferred/predicted/unknown evidence.
REASONER fuses the specialist lanes, source independence, contradictions and uncertainty; conclusions require supporting evidence and unresolved conflicts remain visible.
HAWKEYE coordinates BHOOMIPUTRA field perception, diagnostic/reference systems, geo/field platforms, learning and mobile evidence without creating a second authority.
MobileEdgeBot decides what the phone should process/send; EvidenceCuratorBot decides what evidence is worth retaining; neither can promote observations directly to Gyan truth.
HAWKEYE raw camera/audio evidence remains local/private by default and authentication secrets are never learned or synchronized.

HAWKEYE Learning Observer may learn from user-selected camera/video/book/page/object/audio observations by storing distilled findings plus provenance, then routing candidates through Universal Learning -> BRAHMA -> the appropriate Rishi team.

Unknown faces/face embeddings must not be used to discover a person's web or social-media identity; public identity research requires a user-supplied identity, an enrolled+consented local match, or ordinary public clues.
Mobile HAWKEYE may use local object tracking for overlay geometry and device-supported camera zoom; coarse detector labels remain OBSERVED hints rather than exact semantic identity.

groups.title: BHOOMIPUTRA field, structure and live perception
requirements: BHOOMIPUTRA covers terrain/quarry, buildings/towers/bridges, roads, machinery, utilities, people/PPE, vehicles, electronics/devices, documents/screens, hazards and temporal scene change.
Live field analysis uses local vision by default and marks important findings observed, measured, estimated, inferred or unknown.
People analysis may report count, visible PPE/activity and face presence; identity matching is limited to explicitly enrolled, consented local profiles and unknown identity remains UNKNOWN.

Ordinary OCR may read signs, labels, serial/model numbers, asset tags and requested registration/plate text; passwords, PINs, OTPs, API keys and session/bearer tokens are always redacted and never stored/learned/synced.

Camera-only structure analysis never claims hidden reinforcement, foundation state, certified load capacity, exact material grade, subsurface reserves or original design intent without supporting evidence.
Camera-only vehicle/electronics analysis remains preliminary; hidden faults require OBD/CAN/J1939, electrical instruments, device telemetry or other measurement evidence.
Field evidence can be retained only through bounded encrypted evidence storage and provenance-aware handoff to KRISHNA/HAWKEYE.

groups.title: Deep electronics, vehicle and acoustic diagnostics
requirements: ElectronicsDiagnosticWorker uses a stable read-only evidence adapter for supplied multimeter/oscilloscope/test-point measurements plus schematic/boardview/netlist/reference alignment. Hardware transport/control remains separate and cannot be implied by diagnosis.

VehicleDiagnosticWorker uses a receive/read-only OBD-II/CAN/CAN-FD/J1939 evidence adapter. Common OBD values and J1939 frame metadata may be decoded; bus transmission, ECU programming, actuation and automatic DTC clearing are prohibited.

AcousticDiagnosticWorker uses bounded audio/vibration measurement features (RMS, peak, crest factor, zero-crossing rate and dominant frequencies) without retaining raw samples by default; fault labels still require baseline/reference evidence.
The diagnostic coordinator uses test -> measurement -> hypothesis -> next test -> repair -> retest; model output or a single measurement alone cannot mark a hardware fault verified.
Mains/high-voltage/traction-battery evidence triggers explicit hazard handling; the software adapter never authorizes energized probing.

groups.title: Canonical mobile edge and evidence pipeline
requirements: There must be one canonical Android source/runtime; mobile_v3 and any deployed companion history must be reconciled rather than maintained as competing products.
MobileEdgeBot performs lightweight device/network/resource-aware preprocessing and decides what should stay local, be compacted, or be sent to PC.
EvidenceCuratorBot retains only useful bounded evidence, encrypts it locally, synchronizes on approved private transport, and deletes phone copies only after retained-PC acknowledgement.
Offline mode continues conversation/evidence capture and lightweight inference where supported; unsupported heavy reasoning is queued for later PC processing rather than falsely reported complete.
Camera/audio sampling is bounded by cadence, TTL, item count and byte budgets so Hawkeye does not overload phone or PC.
Mobile and PC share one KRISHNA conversation/action state while the phone remains a conversation-first interface rather than a raw system dashboard.
User-requested HAWKEYE photos/videos may be saved locally with a bounded metadata sidecar; saving does not imply cloud upload and secrets are excluded from capture metadata.
On-device object tracking and auto-zoom must remain bounded and must not block or overload the primary KRISHNA conversation loop.

groups.title: Verification, duplication and release discipline
requirements: Every requirement is classified as VERIFIED, IMPLEMENTED_NOT_VERIFIED, PARTIAL, MISSING, ROADMAP or SUPERSEDED.
Compatibility/source snapshots such as GARUDANETRA_SOURCE and KRISHNA_AGI_V1_IMPLEMENTED are never treated as canonical runtime implementations.
Duplicate implementations must have an explicit canonical owner and compatibility/deprecation reason; dead or unreachable modules are reported rather than silently retained as proof of capability.
A release requires current Windows runtime acceptance, browser/UI verification, applicable Android real-device acceptance, recovery/rollback evidence and deployment-integrity proof.
Hardware-dependent Glass/RTK/depth/CAN/instrument features may have software adapters implemented but remain HARDWARE_UNVERIFIED until tested with real hardware.

groups.title: LAB BOT — Rishi practical experiment and laboratory bridge
requirements: LAB BOT is KRISHNA's bounded bridge from Rishi hypotheses to practical experiments; it does not replace KRISHNA, BRAHMA, the Rishi Council or Sudarshan authority.

Every LAB BOT experiment preserves the requesting Rishi, hypothesis, objective, domain, independent/dependent variables, controls, measurements, success criteria, source references, limitations and replication requirements when supplied.
Simulation/dry-run is the default first execution path and may validate experimental structure without claiming that a physical or biomedical result has been demonstrated.
Physical laboratory execution may occur only through an explicitly registered adapter and requires explicit owner/Sudarshan approval plus protocol review.
Biological, biomedical, medical, pharmacological, chemical and wet-lab physical execution additionally requires an approved facility context and a confirmed human operator.
Rishis may request, inspect and simulate LAB BOT experiments but do not receive unrestricted raw hardware, shell or laboratory-control authority.

Successful and failed experimental evidence, measurements, limitations and provenance are retained; practical findings require independent replication/review before promotion as verified Gyan-Bhandar knowledge.
Quantum Lab provides software-first circuit simulation, quantum research planning and provider discovery; simulator output is never represented as real-QPU evidence or quantum advantage.

Nano Lab provides nanoscale geometry/materials research planning and optional materials-tool provider discovery; geometric or atomistic models are never represented as verified physical fabrication or biological efficacy.

Quantum/Nano joint research prioritizes quantum materials, quantum dots, nanophotonics, spin defects, nanoscale quantum sensing and molecular/materials simulation while keeping classical/materials baselines and uncertainty visible.

Physical nanofabrication, quantum hardware, quantum-materials fabrication and nanomaterials laboratory work remain facility-reviewed, human-supervised and hardware-unverified until real adapters are accepted.

release_gates: Source/runtime integrity is SYNCED to a verified deployment manifest.
Windows compile/unit/contracts and real runtime smoke tests pass.
Sudarshan project/chat/attachment/action workflows pass.
Garudanetra real browser work, evidence and recovery paths pass.
NARAD create/promote/execute/history and external-action gates pass.
Gyan-Bhandar candidate -> approval -> verified recall passes.
KABACH boundaries and Policy gates pass.
Mobile pairing/resume/conversation/notification tests pass on device.
Voice/avatar unavailable providers fail honestly and configured providers pass runtime checks.
Restart/recovery/rollback and CPU/RAM governance pass before final EXE packaging.
Encrypted credential vault and free-only model routing contracts pass.
Attachment -> local vision -> conversation evidence path passes with unsupported providers failing honestly.
Private remote transport policy rejects public Internet clients.
Crash-loop quarantine and critical-memory model unload boundaries pass.
Garudanetra browser-mode lifecycle and owner-control actions pass.
Wearable vendor capabilities remain unverified until hardware evidence exists.
Garuda research and Garudanetra browser/computer responsibilities remain separate in runtime and UI.
Garudanetra semantic refs, browser-fabric status, frame transport, action recording and replay approval gate pass runtime acceptance.
Shared Action Bus, Agent Runtime, Jobs, Permissions, MCP/A2A adapter and Dispatch acceptance checks pass.
Priority operational UI controls produce real Shared Action receipts; decorative-but-unwired controls are release defects.
NARAD reports typed-dag/sudarshan mode with Sudarshan bound in runtime acceptance.
NARAD checkpoint/resume, bounded retry, safe data mapping and independent workflow verification tests pass.
No full n8n runtime process/dependency is required for KRISHNA Core.
BRAHMAGYAN L0-L8 maturity gates, Rishi council manifests, dual-track knowledge discipline and provenance contracts pass.
BRAHMAGYAN Shishya execution remains approval-gated, capped and temporary; no permanent research worker fleet is introduced.
Minimal sidebar contract passes: no internal runtime modules are exposed as Main Menu items; project delete preserves chats by moving them to global Chats.
KRISHNA Spatial UI Node build passes and runtime shell preserves the minimal KRISHNA/Sudarshan/Plugins sidebar contract.
NARAD inbox/outbox state redacts likely secrets and outbound delivery remains a separate approval-gated provider action.
MCP JSON-RPC transport requires an authenticated principal and cannot expose an unauthenticated public control plane.
Avatar production output passes full body, facial-viseme and required-animation inspection before being reported production-ready.
Field 3D/AR scene generation requires measured GNSS and never upgrades missing depth/photogrammetry/device tracking into verified measurements.
Sudarshan design work is not accepted until Vishvakarma knowledge context, design specification, functional, visual, responsive, accessibility and security gates are satisfied.
Model Scout never promotes an unbenchmarked or duplicate candidate and never treats candidate/provider free labels as proof of non-billable cloud execution.

status_definitions.VERIFIED: Implemented and proven by the required current runtime/device/integration evidence.
status_definitions.IMPLEMENTED_NOT_VERIFIED: Code and tests exist, but required physical/runtime/device acceptance is still outstanding.
status_definitions.PARTIAL: A usable foundation exists, but one or more required product capabilities are not yet implemented or integrated.
status_definitions.MISSING: Required capability is not present in the canonical source.
status_definitions.ROADMAP: Deliberately deferred until prerequisite phases/hardware are ready.
status_definitions.SUPERSEDED: Older implementation or requirement retained only for history/compatibility and not canonical.

definition_of_done: Requirement is present in this canonical ledger and mapped to a canonical implementation owner.
Implementation is reachable from the production runtime rather than only existing as an unused module or stale branch.
Unit tests cover normal and failure behavior.
Integration tests prove the component cooperates with its upstream/downstream runtime contracts.
Mutation or consequential execution remains permissioned, audited and independently verified.
UI work is verified in rendered runtime behavior, not by source presence alone.
Device/hardware capabilities stay IMPLEMENTED_NOT_VERIFIED or HARDWARE_UNVERIFIED until tested on the actual device.
No feature is declared VERIFIED solely because a PR merged or CI compiled.
